warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Read from front.jpg (1050x1275), the image carrying all mandatory text; back.jpg is artwork.

Brand reading is a judgement call, so the whole picture is recorded here. The front's largest text is 'Red Blend', below it 'RED TABLE WINE'. 'THE UGLY' is set in a knit-pattern display face in the middle of the label and is the element that reads as the brand, so it is what brand_name carries. The application's brand name 'UGLY SWEATER' is printed nowhere as a brand mark; it appears only inside the bottler statement 'CELLARED AND BOTTLED BY UGLY SWEATER HEALDSBURG, CA'. The back artwork prints 'UGLY', 'Big Red' and 'CALIFORNIA'.
Bottom line reads 'ALC. 14% BY VOLUME   750ML   CONTAINS SULFITES'.
Warning heading is in capitals and bold.
